variants.prompt: On a rooftop at golden hour, a bohemian beauty stands with her back to the camera, gazing out at the breathtaking cityscape below. She wears a barely-there white bikini that leaves little to the imagination, the golden light of the setting sun casting a warm glow across her toned, sun-kissed body. With her fiery auburn locks swept up in a loose, effortless style, she exudes a bold, confident energy, her posture strong and statuesque as she leans against the railing, a playful, teasing smile playing on her lips. The DSLR camera captures her in a tight, medium shot from behind, the shallow focus emphasizing her figure and the dramatic cityscape behind her.
